project_type: FastAPI + Celery backend (Python 3.11), React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind 4 frontend, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7
build_system: backend: pip + alembic migrations; frontend: npm + Vite; no monorepo tooling — each subdirectory is independent
test_framework: pytest (backend, in backend/tests/*.py); no frontend tests — only npm run build for verification
verification_instructions: 1) cd backend && pytest tests/test_tier4e_backend.py -v (new tests); 2) cd backend && pytest -q (full suite must still pass); 3) cd frontend && npm run build (must exit 0); 4) docker compose config --quiet (validates docker-compose.yml); optionally docker compose build api && docker compose build web
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist/ is generated by npm run build. backend/__pycache__ is generated by pytest. Neither is committed.
environment_constraints: Tests require a running PostgreSQL on localhost:5432 (DATABASE_URL) and Redis on localhost:6379. CI provides both as service containers. The celery_app.py reads REDIS_URL for both broker and backend — do NOT use CELERY_BROKER_URL or CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND. All tests live in backend/tests/ with no conftest.py — each test file is self-contained.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md yet — to be created. Follow existing test file conventions exactly.
key_patterns: 1) Test files: no conftest.py; local _make_user/_create_workspace/_add_member/_auth_headers helpers; @pytest.fixture def db() yields SessionLocal(); autouse reset_limiter_and_tasks patches task apply_async; autouse ensure_encryption_key sets encryption key via _settings_override. 2) React pages: dark theme (gray-900 bg, blue-600 accent, gray-300 text), Tailwind utility classes only, no CSS modules. 3) api.js: apiFetch() is the canonical fetch wrapper; absoluteApiBase() to be added as exported function. 4) Layout.jsx NAV array drives nav links. 5) App.jsx: RequireAuth wrapper for protected routes; useAuth() hook provides {user, isAdmin, isSuperadmin, workspace}.
directory_structure: notification-service/ (repo root): backend/ (FastAPI app, Celery worker, tests, alembic), frontend/ (Vite+React SPA), .github/workflows/ (CI), scripts/ (to be created). backend/app/ contains api/, models/, schemas/, services/, tasks/. frontend/src/ contains components/, lib/, pages/ (pages has settings/ subdirectory).
